ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week  Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Keshon Gilbert
ATL.detail: Gilbert (hip) won't play in Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Wizards  Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: RayJ Dennis
ATL.detail: Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards  Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

BOS.name: Jayson Tatum
BOS.detail: Tatum (knee) should once again serve as the unquestioned centerpiece of Boston's offense after the Celtics traded Jaylen Brown for Paul George  John Schuhmann of NBA.com reports.

BKN.name: Nolan Traore
BKN.detail: Brooklyn general manager Sean Marks announced Monday that Traore underwent right knee surgery and won't play in Summer League  C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

CHA.name: Brandon Miller
CHA.detail: Miller (shoulder) provided an update on his rehab after surgery in comments to Roderick Boone of The Charlotte Observer on Tuesday.

CHA.name: PJ Hall
CHA.detail: The Hornets announced Thursday that Hall underwent a procedure to address a fractured right ankle and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 campaign.

CHI.name: Dailyn Swain
CHI.detail: Swain is out for Friday's Summer League game against the Cavaliers due to right wrist soreness  per K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network.

CHI.name: Zach Collins
CHI.detail: Collins (toe) agreed to a two-year  $17 million extension with Chicago on Tuesday  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

CHI.name: Josh Giddey
CHI.detail: Giddey (ankle) could benefit from the selections of Caleb Wilson and Dailyn Swain as well as Chicago's acquisition of Nic Claxton (finger) in 2026-27.

CHI.name: Rob Dillingham
CHI.detail: Dillingham recently underwent successful minor surgery to have a ganglion cyst removed from his right wrist  the Bulls announced Wednesday.

DAL.name: Kyrie Irving
DAL.detail: Irving (knee) has been playing in pickup games this offseason in an effort to ramp up toward his return to the court in 2026-27  Tim MacMahon of ESPN reports.

DAL.name: Santi Aldama
DAL.detail: Aldama (knee) is expected to be ready in time for training camp  according to NBA reporter Marc Stein.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.detail: Lively (foot) still hasn't progressed to running yet  per Christian Clark of The Athletic.

DEN.name: Trevon Brazile
DEN.detail: Brazile is out for Sunday's Summer League finale for undisclosed reasons  Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.

GSW.name: Jimmy Butler III
GSW.detail: Butler (knee) is still in the relatively early stages of his recovery and has only recently begun getting back on the court  according to Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com.

GSW.name: Moses Moody
GSW.detail: Moody has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Fred VanVleet
HOU.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Friday that VanVleet (knee) is ramping up his rehab work  Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

HOU.name: Kevin Durant
HOU.detail: Durant (ankle) averaged 26.0 points per game during his first season with Houston and continued to cement his place among the NBA's all-time great scorers  moving into the top five on the league's career 30-point games list.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.detail: The Rockets announced Wednesday that Adams has undergone season-ending left ankle surgery  per Shams Charania of ESPN.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.detail: The Pacers may opt to slowly bring Haliburton back up to speed as he aims to return from a torn Achilles suffered in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals  Jamal Collier of ESPN reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season  Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

LAC.name: Brandon Ingram
LAC.detail: The Clippers and Raptors both agreed Monday to finalize the trade sending Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram (heel)  Gradey Dick  two unprotected first-round picks  one first-round pick swap and two second-rounders  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months  per Law Murray of The Athletic.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.detail: Beal (hip) agreed to a two-year  $13.2 million contract with Los Angeles on Thursday  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.detail: Niederhauser has been diagnosed with a Lisfranc injury in his right foot and will require surgery. He's been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season  Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.detail: Pippen (toe) has a chance to begin the new year as Memphis' starting point guard after Portland acquired Ja Morant in a trade with the Grizzlies earlier this offseason.

MEM.name: Walter Clayton Jr.
MEM.detail: Clayton (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League title game against the Warriors  Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

MEM.name: Karim Lopez
MEM.detail: Lopez (undisclosed) is out for Sunday's Summer League championship game against the Warriors  Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.detail: Saunders was selected by the Grizzlies with the No. 32 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft.

MEM.name: Jaylen Wells
MEM.detail: Wells (toe) should continue competing for rotation minutes on the wing despite Memphis adding Cameron Boozer with the No. 3 overall pick.

MEM.name: Zach Edey
MEM.detail: Edey's (ankle  elbow) role becomes more intriguing following Memphis' addition of Cameron Boozer.

MIA.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
MIA.detail: Antetokounmpo (knee) did not participate in Greece's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he focused on preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

MIA.name: Bam Adebayo
MIA.detail: Adebayo's (back) fantasy outlook should remain strong after Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo  though his offensive role could shift alongside another high-usage frontcourt star  Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sentinel opines.

MIA.name: Trevor Keels
MIA.detail: Keels (knee) didn't play in Friday's 101-87 Summer League win over the Pistons.

MIA.name: Ryan Conwell
MIA.detail: Conwell (hip) won't play again during the Las Vegas Summer League  per Tim Reynolds of Associated Press.

MIA.name: Myron Gardner
MIA.detail: Gardner (ankle) won't participate in the Las Vegas Summer League  per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

MIL.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
MIL.detail: Porter exercised his $5.39 million player option for the 2026-27 campaign Thursday  Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.detail: DiVincenzo will undergo surgery Sunday to repair a ruptured right Achilles tendon that he suffered during the Timberwolves Game 4 win over the Nuggets on Saturday.

NOP.name: Bryce McGowens
NOP.detail: McGowens (toe) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves.

NYK.name: Jalen Brunson
NYK.detail: Brunson (wrist) is expected to be ready for training camp  ESPN's Vincent Goodwill reports.

NYK.name: Mohamed Diawara
NYK.detail: Diawara (finger) didn't play in Friday's 110-88 Summer League loss to the Mavericks.

OKC.name: Isaiah Hartenstein
OKC.detail: Hartenstein (ankle) participated in an offseason workout with the Thunder on Monday  Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Ajay Mitchell
OKC.detail: According to Bryan Toporek of Forbes  Oklahoma City's offseason roster shakeup opened additional opportunities in the backcourt after the departures of Isaiah Joe  Aaron Wiggins and Luguentz Dort.

OKC.name: Otega Oweh
OKC.detail: Oweh (lower leg) didn't play in Sunday's 108-90 Summer League loss to the Nets.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.detail: Sorber underwent a successful minor arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Wednesday and will return to full basketball activities in approximately four weeks  Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's Game 7 of the Western Conference Finals against the Spurs.

OKC.name: Nikola Topic
OKC.detail: Topic (back) underwent surgery Saturday and is expected to be ready for the start of training camp  Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.

ORL.name: Franz Wagner
ORL.detail: Wagner (calf) did not participate in Germany's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he focuses on preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.detail: The Magic announced Monday that Nelson will undergo surgery to repair a fracture in his left ankle  and he's expected to return to basketball activities in 3-4 months.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.detail: Isaac (knee) will return to the Magic on a one-year deal  Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

PHI.name: Adem Bona
PHI.detail: Bona (foot) will be re-evaluated at the start of training camp  Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

PHI.name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
PHI.detail: Caldwell-Pope (finger) agreed to a buyout with the Grizzlies on Saturday and plans to sign a one-year  $3.9 million contract with the 76ers  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

PHX.name: Duop Reath
PHX.detail: Reath (foot) agreed to a one-year veteran minimum contract with the Suns on Wednesday  John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

PHX.name: CJ Huntley
PHX.detail: Huntley (hamstring) is out for Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League finale versus the Spurs  Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.detail: Morant is set to share the playmaking duties with Damian Lillard in Portland's starting backcourt after being traded from Memphis.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months  per Shams Charania of ESPN.

POR.name: Damian Lillard
POR.detail: Lillard (Achilles) defeated Devin Booker and Kon Knueppel in the final round of Saturday's 2026 State Farm 3-Point Contest  taking home his third title.

SAC.name: Domantas Sabonis
SAC.detail: Sabonis (knee) did not participate in Lithuania's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he turned his attention toward preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

SAC.name: Keegan Murray
SAC.detail: Murray (ankle) is projected to start at power forward for the Kings in 2026-27  according to Kings beat writer Chris Watkins.

SAC.name: Zach LaVine
SAC.detail: LaVine (hand) exercised his $49 million player option for 2026-27 on Monday  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

SAC.name: De'Andre Hunter
SAC.detail: Hunter (eye) has a major competitor for usage after the Kings took Darius Acuff in the 2026 WNBA Draft.

SAS.name: David Jones Garcia
SAS.detail: Jones Garcia (ankle) agreed to a two-way contract with the Spurs on Wednesday  per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

SAS.name: Jayden Quaintance
SAS.detail: Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return  Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.detail: Bittle (lower leg) was spotted in a walking boot Wednesday  Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

TOR.name: Alijah Martin
TOR.detail: Martin (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets  Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

TOR.name: Chucky Hepburn
TOR.detail: Hepburn (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets  Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

TOR.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
TOR.detail: Murray-Boyles (finger) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets  Zulfi Sheikh of sportsnet reports.

UTA.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTA.detail: With Walker Kessler now in Los Angeles  Jackson (knee) figures to be an even more essential piece for the Jazz in 2026-27  per ESPN's Tim MacMahon.

UTA.name: Trey Alexander
UTA.detail: Alexander (rib) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Portland  per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.

WAS.name: Jamir Watkins
WAS.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

WAS.name: Alex Sarr
WAS.detail: Washington's selection of AJ Dybantsa likely won't significantly alter Sarr's role heading into his third NBA season

WAS.name: Anthony Davis
WAS.detail: The Wizards selected AJ Dybantsa with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft  adding another high-usage scorer to the roster.

WAS.name: Trae Young
WAS.detail: Young (quadriceps) plans to sign a four-year  $212 million deal with the Wizards  Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
